answers.reason: Students are not mentioned as members of the senate, which decides on statutes, structure, and strategy of the whole university.
Students are not mentioned among the groups that take part in budget planning rounds.
Students are not mentioned as members of appointment committees that select candidates for professorships.
Students are not mentioned as participants in faculty councils.
Examination boards decide on examination matters of individual students, but students do not sit as members on these boards.
